description: Make a persona PERFORM a reply: the body lip-syncs the text and shows the matching facial expression and body gesture. Pass the persona_id and the exact text the agent is saying this turn; the emotion is detected from the text automatically (or set it explicitly). The returned view animates the body for this turn: show it alongside the reply. This is the turn-by-turn embodiment hook.

emotion.description: Optional explicit emotion override; omit to auto-detect from the text.

text.description: The reply text the agent is saying this turn: drives lip-sync and emotion.

name: persona_say
title: Speak a reply through a persona: lip-sync + emotion + gesture
